paragraphs.en: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate 7 model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals (rank-1 finishes), while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players’ matches. These results highlight HL’s potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
paragraphs.zh: 对抗性游戏推动了从启发式搜索到强化学习的进步，然而，如何在有限样本中学习并调整策略仍然是一项挑战。 AI 智能体提供了一种替代方案：将游戏经验转化为可执行策略的修订版本。 在启发式学习（HL）的基础上，我们正式提出了对抗性启发式学习（AHL）这一范式，该范式利用 AI 智能体作为学习引擎来优化游戏策略及相关软件，同时保持模型权重固定不变。 我们推出了 AAArena——一个基准测试平台，包含 12 款真实的对抗性游戏和 1,920 个存档的人类程序，其评估协议以真实世界中的游戏竞赛为蓝本。 智能体能够解读规则、选择对手、分析重播，并修订游戏智能体，从而在固定的比赛和评估预算内实现最高排名。 我们评估了 7 种模型与工具配置：Opus5.5 搭配 Claude Code 获得了 6 枚金牌（即第 1 名的成绩），而其他所有被评估的配置均未在其余 6 个人类等级榜中取得第一。 在游戏规则说明更为复杂的情况下，整体表现通常较弱。 进一步实验表明，对手选择和密集反馈有助于策略改进，且智能体能够从自身比赛的在策略重播和其他玩家的离策略重播中同时学习。 这些结果凸显了启发式学习在对抗性游戏中的潜力，同时也指出了游戏理解、策略执行以及长期策略开发方面持续存在的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial games have long served as a testing ground for artificial intelligence. Early systems relied on hand-crafted heuristics, evaluation functions, and tree search; reinforcement learning and self-play subsequently advanced experience-driven policy optimization ( Campbell et al., 2002 ; Coulom, 2007 ; Silver et al., 2018 ) . Opponents form part of each player’s environment, and changes in their strategies shift the learning target. Adapting and revising strategies in a changing environment with limited interaction remains a challenge ( Hernandez-Leal et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对抗性游戏长期以来一直是人工智能的测试场。 早期系统依赖人工设计的启发式方法、评估函数和树搜索；随后，强化学习和自我对弈推动了基于经验的策略优化（Campbell 等，2002；Coulom，2007；Silver 等，2018）。 对手是每位玩家环境的一部分，其策略的变化会改变学习目标。 在互动有限且不断变化的环境中调整并修订策略仍然是一项挑战（Hernandez-Leal 等，2019）。

paragraphs.en: AI agents now work in code repositories ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . They also operate graphical interfaces ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , while agent-design and recursive program-improvement methods let models revise the software supporting their behaviour ( Hu et al., 2025c ; Zelikman et al., 2024 ) . These capabilities suggest that AI agents can serve as learning engines. In Learning Beyond Gradients , Weng (2026) describes heuristic learning (HL), in which an AI agent accumulates experience in editable software structures. The agent reads failures, logs, and replays to revise programs and their supporting software. Recent work also studies program-policy revision and tournament-based code evolution ( Garnier et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能智能体如今已在代码仓库中工作（Yang 等，2024）。 它们还能操作图形用户界面（Xie 等，2024），而智能体设计法和递归程序改进法则能让模型修订支持其行为的软件（Hu 等，2025c；Zelikman 等，2024）。 这些能力表明，人工智能智能体可以充当学习引擎。 在《超越梯度的学习》一书中，Weng（2026）描述了启发式学习（HL），其中人工智能智能体在可编辑的软件结构中积累经验。 该智能体通过读取失败记录、日志和重播来修订程序及其支持软件。 近期的研究还探讨了程序策略的修订以及基于竞赛的代码演化（Garnier 等，2026；Wang 等，2026；Fu 等，2026；Yang 等，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: The Tsinghua University Agent Competition is an annual programming competition in which contestants build game agents to compete in adversarial games ( Saiblo, ) . Each year, organizers introduce a new game and publish its rules. Contestants interpret the rules, design executable strategies, and improve their programs through freely chosen matches to compete for leaderboard positions.

paragraphs.en: Success: reaching rank 1. Rollman , MoneCraft , Pacman , and AquaWar reach rank 1 and stop before exhausting the full-pool evaluation budget. These runs show that feedback-driven program revision can produce policies that top the human-program ladders within the given interaction limits.

paragraphs.en: Progress: gains with regressions. AntWar , Dorado , LostSpace , SnakeGo , and AntWar2 improve overall, but individual revisions can reduce performance. Retaining the best evaluated policy preserves earlier gains when later edits regress.
paragraphs.zh: 进展：伴随着性能下降而取得的进步。 AntWar、Dorado、LostSpace、SnakeGo 和 AntWar2 的整体表现有所提升，但个别修改可能会降低性能。 Dorado 在运行过程中间阶段连续取得多次进步，而 AntWar2 则出现了一次急剧的中间性下降，LostSpace 最终以长时间波动结束。 保留评估表现最佳的策略可以在后续修改导致性能下降时，保住早期的进步成果。

paragraphs.en: Dorado has two players, each controlling a base and recruiting heroes from four classes. Mining supplies gold for recruitment and for upgrading heroes near the base. Destroying the opposing base wins; simultaneous destruction draws. If both bases remain at the turn limit, gold plus the level-based value of each player’s heroes determines the result.
paragraphs.zh: Dorado 有两名玩家，每人控制一个基地，并从四个职业中招募英雄。 采矿获得的黄金可用于招募英雄以及升级基地附近的英雄。 摧毁敌方基地即可获胜；若双方基地同时被毁，则比赛平局。 如果回合数达到上限时双方基地都仍然存在，则根据黄金数量加上每位玩家英雄基于等级的价值来决定胜负。

sents.zh: Dorado 有两名玩家，每人控制一个基地，并从四个职业中招募英雄。

paragraphs.en: Correct mine allocation. The central mine stays open, while other mines have limited opening windows. Each mine uses the highest individual mining rate; sending several heroes to one mine does not add their yields. The agent excludes dead miners from occupancy counts, penalizes assigning several miners to the same mine, and tracks mine opening windows. After these revisions, the policy reaches rank 14.
paragraphs.zh: 修正矿场分配。 中央矿场保持开放，而其他矿场的开放窗口则有限。 每个矿场都使用最高的单矿开采率；向一个矿场派遣多个英雄并不会增加它们的产出。 智能体在占用人数统计中排除已死亡的矿工，对将多个矿工分配至同一矿场的行为进行惩罚，并追踪矿场的开放窗口。 经过这些调整，该策略的排名达到了第 14 位。

paragraphs.en: We compare four opponent-selection strategies. Model selection lets the agent choose opponents, as in the main experiment. The ladder starts at rank 30 and moves toward stronger opponents without returning to weaker ones. Random sampling draws uniformly from the pool; top-four uses only the four highest-ranked opponents. All conditions use dense feedback and a small-match batch size of four.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了四种对手选择策略。 模型选择允许智能体选择对手，如同主实验中的做法。 该排名从第 30 位开始，逐步向更强对手推进，而不会回到较弱的对手。 随机抽样从池中均匀抽取；前四名策略仅使用排名最高的四名对手。 所有条件均使用密集反馈和每批四个样本的小规模匹配设置。

paragraphs.en: The ladder leads on Pacman and AntWar , while model selection leads on Miracle (Figure 6 ). Model selection outperforms random and top-four selection in all three games; the ladder trails random selection on Miracle . Top-four selection yields the lowest Elo throughout. One hypothesis is that gradually stronger or agent-selected opponents provide more actionable feedback than repeated mismatches.

paragraphs.en: Competitive program-development benchmarks differ in their outputs, opponents, feedback, and revision protocols (Table 5 ). GACL evaluates generated game agents and ProxyWar includes code repair ( Game Agent Coding League, n.d. ; Peng et al., 2026 ) ; the vibe-coding tournament compares student and model programs with a self-play refinement condition ( Danassis and Goel, 2025 ) . CATArena supplies tournament logs and peer code across revision rounds ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , while CodeClash studies competitive code evolution and CC:Ladder advances through ranked human programs after each win ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . EvoPolicyGym budgets episodes in single-agent environments and uses hidden validation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . AAArena combines 12 custom competition games, archived human-written programs, and agent-selected testing, with separate budgets for small matches and full-pool evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 竞争性程序开发基准测试在输出、对手、反馈和修订协议方面存在差异（表5）。 GACL评估生成的游戏智能体，而ProxyWar包含代码修复（游戏智能体编码联盟，未注明日期；Peng等，2026）；vibe-coding锦标赛则将学生和模型程序置于自我对弈优化条件下进行比较（Danassis和Goel，2025）。 CATArena在修订轮次中提供锦标赛日志和同伴代码（Fu等，2026），而CodeClash研究竞争性代码演化，CC:Ladder则在每次获胜后通过排名靠前的人类程序推进（Yang等，2026a）。 EvoPolicyGym为单智能体环境分配回合预算，并使用隐藏验证机制（Wang等，2026）。 AAArena整合了12款定制竞赛游戏、存档的人类编写程序以及由智能体选择的测试用例，并为小型比赛和完整池评估设置了独立的预算。

paragraphs.en: Weng’s HL incorporates experience through revisions to program policies and supporting software ( Weng, 2026 ) . Programmatic reinforcement learning and LLM-guided program search also use programs as policy representations ( Verma et al., 2018 ; Bastani et al., 2018 ; Eberhardinger et al., 2025 ; Kuang et al., 2025 ) . Related systems improve controllers, algorithms, and agent software ( Garnier et al., 2026 ; Romera-Paredes et al., 2023 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025c ; Zelikman et al., 2024 ) , or revise rewards and training procedures ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Chi et al., 2026 ) . Trajectory distillation extracts reusable skills from replay ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . AHL applies HL to competitive game-agent development, where the AI agent revises policies and supporting software with a fixed base model.

paragraphs.en: We present AAArena to evaluate AI agents that develop executable game policies through adversarial heuristic learning (AHL). The benchmark combines 12 real-world competition games, archived human programs, and a unified two-budget protocol. Across 7 AI models, Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals; no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Dense feedback supports policy improvement in the ablations, and agents also improve by learning from both on-policy and off-policy replays. Qualitative analysis of code revisions and trajectories points to challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon planning. By making this development process measurable, AAArena provides a foundation for research on heuristic learning and self-evolving AI agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AAArena，用于评估通过对抗性启发式学习（AHL）开发可执行游戏策略的 AI 智能体。 该基准测试结合了 12 款真实世界中的竞技游戏、存档的人类程序以及统一的“双预算”协议。 在 7 款 AI 模型中，使用 Claude Code 的 Opus5.5 获得了 6 枚金牌；所有受评估的配置均未超越其余 6 个人类水平榜单。 密集反馈有助于消融实验中的策略改进，智能体通过从在策略和离策略重播中学习也能得到提升。 对代码修订和轨迹的定性分析表明，游戏理解、策略执行和长期规划方面仍存在挑战。 通过使这一开发过程可衡量，AAArena 为启发式学习和自我演化的 AI 智能体研究提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Pacman is a separate, symmetric competitive maze game. Players collect ordinary and high-value beans , avoid monsters , and place mines that affect movement choices. paragraphs.en: MoneCraft is a mining and resource-control game on a symmetric map. Players capture mines that generate currency and can teleport, place mines , or purchase protection. The policy trades movement and disruption against sustained resource production; end-game currency and mine ownership determine the result under the referee’s rules.
paragraphs.zh: MoneCraft 是一款在对称地图上进行采矿和资源控制的游戏。 玩家可以占领能产生货币的矿点，还可以传送、放置矿点或购买保护。 该策略将移动和干扰与持续的资源产出进行权衡；游戏结束时，货币和矿点的所有权将在裁判规则下决定最终结果。

sents.zh: 一项有效的政策应将经济发展与攻击的时机和方向相协调，而不是单独优化其中任何一个方面。

paragraphs.en: Dorado combines resource competition with hero and army development. Players choose heroes , produce and command units , mine neutral resources, and invest in upgrades . The policy coordinates movement, combat, harvesting, and abilities to threaten opposing bases while maintaining the resources needed to continue production.
paragraphs.zh: Dorado 将资源竞争与英雄和军队发展相结合。 玩家可以选择英雄、生产和指挥单位、采集中立资源，并投资升级。 该策略协调了移动、战斗、采集和能力运用，以威胁敌方基地，同时维持持续生产所需的资源。

sents.en: Dorado combines resource competition with hero and army development.
sents.zh: Dorado 将资源竞争与英雄和军队发展相结合。

sents.zh: 玩家可以选择英雄、生产和指挥单位、采集中立资源，并投资升级。

paragraphs.en: Miracle is a hex-grid strategy game with heterogeneous units and an initial drafting stage. A player selects creatures and an artifact , then summons, moves, attacks, and uses abilities to destroy the opponent’s miracle . Resource limits and unit interactions make tactical coordination central to the policy.
paragraphs.zh: 《奇迹》是一款基于六边形网格的策略游戏，拥有异质单位以及初始的选牌阶段。 玩家需选择生物和一件神器，然后召唤、移动、攻击并使用能力来摧毁对手的奇迹。 资源限制和单位互动使得战术协调成为策略的核心。

paragraphs.en: LOTA is a lane-based combat game. Each player chooses a hero and controls movement, attacks, abilities, skill development, and revival while units advance along fixed lanes . Victory depends on destroying the opposing base or the referee’s settlement criteria at the turn limit. Effective control couples immediate fights with sustained pressure on defensive structures.
paragraphs.zh: LOTA 是一款基于战道的战斗游戏。 每位玩家选择一名英雄，并在单位沿固定战道推进的过程中控制其移动、攻击、技能、技能成长以及复活。 胜利取决于摧毁敌方基地，或在回合限制时满足裁判的判定标准。 有效的控制能将即时战斗与对防御建筑的持续压力相结合。

paragraphs.en: AntWar2 extends tower-defence strategy with ordered operation lists whose accepted prefix changes subsequent decisions. The agent must coordinate tower placement , economic development, and weapon timing while respecting sequence-dependent legality.

paragraphs.en: Each model–game run uses one persistent session with a writable workspace. Opus5.5 runs in Claude Code; the other models run in Codex. The agent’s goal is to improve competitive performance. It chooses when to read rules, edit code, test selected opponents, and submit a full-pool evaluation. Small matches return replays; full-pool evaluations return Elo, rank, and per-opponent outcomes. Context compaction preserves the session but shortens its conversation history, so the agent keeps notes to retain experience. We report the run’s highest officially evaluated Elo, including the common initialization baseline, and its corresponding rank. The controller retains the policy snapshot attaining that score.
paragraphs.zh: 每次模型–游戏运行都会使用一个具有可写工作区的持久会话。 Opus5.5 在 Claude Code 中运行；其他模型则在 Codex 中运行。 智能体的目标是提升竞技表现。 它会决定何时读取规则、编辑代码、测试选定的对手，以及提交完整池评估。 小型对局会返回重播记录；完整池评估则会返回 Elo、排名和每位对手的对局结果。 上下文压缩会保留会话内容，但会缩短其对话历史，因此智能体需要记录笔记以保留经验。 我们报告此次运行中经官方评估的最高 Elo（包括通用的初始化基线）及其对应的排名。 控制器会保留达到该分数的策略快照。

paragraphs.en: We compare rule-description sizes by rewriting each game’s rules in a shared formal pseudocode language. Its domain-neutral vocabulary includes top-level declarations ( constant , enum , entity , action , observation , setup , rule , terminal ), fifteen statement types, and expressions for arithmetic, comparisons, and function calls. Statement types include let , require , when , for , update , create , delete , reveal , and return . Set membership, distance, and probability are primitives. We explicitly define every game-specific operation, such as splitting a snake or casting a fish skill. Each description covers players, information, state, initialization, randomness, legal actions, transitions, and termination. We exclude communication protocols, rendering, logging, and platform-only timeouts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将每款游戏的规则改写为一种共享的正式伪代码语言，来比较规则描述的大小。 其领域无关的词汇表包括顶层声明（constant、enum、entity、action、observation、setup、rule、terminal）、十五种语句类型，以及用于算术运算、比较和函数调用的表达式。 语句类型包括 let、require、when、for、update、create、delete、reveal 和 return。 集合成员关系、距离和概率均为原语。 我们明确定义了每款游戏特有的所有操作，例如分割蛇身或使用钓鱼技能。 每个描述都涵盖了玩家、信息、状态、初始化、随机性、合法动作、状态转换和终止条件。 我们不包含通信协议、渲染、日志记录以及平台专属的超时机制。

paragraphs.en: The secondary measure, rule atoms (RA), counts independently changeable rule propositions. Each declaration member or rule statement expresses exactly one such proposition; two effects written in one sentence still count as two. RA is the size of the disjoint union of seven proposition classes: state, action, observation, setup, condition, transition, and outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 次要度量标准——规则原子（RA），用于统计可独立变化的规则命题。 每个声明成员或规则陈述都恰好表达这样一个命题；即使两个效应写在同一句话中，仍计为两个。 RA 是七个命题类——状态、动作、观察、设置、条件、转换和结果——的互斥并集的大小。

paragraphs.en: Equal interaction budgets permit different token expenditure. paragraphs.en: Rule-based control: hand-written if – else priorities, state machines, and fixed openings or scripts.
paragraphs.zh: 基于规则的控制：手动编写的 if–else 优先级、状态机以及固定的开局或脚本。

paragraphs.en: Heuristic scoring: hand-weighted features that score candidate actions or targets, followed by a greedy choice.
paragraphs.zh: 启发式评分：通过人工加权特征对候选动作或目标进行评分，然后进行贪心选择。

paragraphs.en: Graph search: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, A*, distance maps, flood fill, and territory partitions.
paragraphs.zh: 图搜索：BFS、DFS、Dijkstra、A*、距离图、洪水填充和区域划分。

paragraphs.en: Lookahead search: search over a forward model, including simulated rollouts, beam search, minimax, expectimax, and MCTS.
paragraphs.zh: 前瞻搜索：在正向模型上进行搜索，包括模拟展开、束搜索、极小化极大搜索、期望极大化搜索和蒙特卡洛树搜索。

paragraphs.en: Combinatorial optimization: assignment and matching, dynamic programming, and knapsack-style allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 组合优化：分配与匹配、动态规划以及背包式分配。

paragraphs.en: Inference and randomization: belief tracking over hidden information, opponent modelling, and mixed or randomized choices.
paragraphs.zh: 推理与随机化：对隐藏信息的信念追踪、对手建模，以及混合或随机选择。

paragraphs.en: We analyse source files in each champion’s strategy directory, excluding byte-identical SDK files and paths matching version, backup, debugging, test, or vendor filters. We assign each function a family based on its structure and identifiers. For functions longer than 40 lines, we classify 20-line windows separately. We exclude I/O, parsing, and protocol code as infrastructure. A family’s share is its fraction of the remaining non-comment lines. Table 10 reports each model–game pair and equally weighted means across models and games.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析每个冠军策略目录中的源文件，但排除字节完全相同的 SDK 文件以及匹配版本、备份、调试、测试或供应商过滤器的路径。 我们根据函数的结构和标识符为每个函数分配一个家族。 对于超过 40 行的函数，我们将每 20 行作为一个窗口分别分类。 我们将 I/O、解析和协议代码排除在外，视为基础设施。 一个家族的份额是其在剩余非注释行中所占的比例。 表 10 报告了每个模型–游戏组合以及跨模型和游戏的等权重平均值。

paragraphs.en: Retained champions rely mainly on rules and heuristic scoring. Averaging the 84 champion-level shares equally, these families account for 79%, graph search for 13%, and the other three families for 8%. Lookahead search exceeds 10% in only 7 of the 84 champions, all on AntWar , AntWar2 , and Generals . These endpoint classifications describe policy composition; they do not identify which code changes caused improvements during development.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的冠军主要依赖规则和启发式评分。 将 84 个冠军级别的份额平均分配，这些家族占 79%，图搜索占 13%，其余三个家族占 8%。 在 84 个冠军中，只有 7 个的前瞻搜索超过 10%，且全部出现在 AntWar、AntWar2 和 Generals 中。 这些终点的分类描述了策略的构成；它们并未指出开发过程中哪些代码变更带来了改进。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm shares differ across games. Graph search accounts for 33% on Pacman and 28% on Rollman ; inference accounts for 30% on AquaWar . MoneCraft and LOTA consist almost entirely of rules. Across models, Opus5.5 has the lowest rule share (47%) and the highest scoring (27%) and lookahead shares (5%); GPT6-sol has the highest graph-search share (18%). The other models range from 58% to 65% rules.

sents.en: The other models range from 58% to 65% rules.

paragraphs.en: Within each game, we correlate non-rule share ( 1 − 1- rule-based fraction) with Elo across the seven configurations, using average ranks for ties. The mean Spearman correlation across 12 games is 0.35 0.35 , with variation across games. This association does not establish that replacing rules improves a policy.
paragraphs.zh: 在每场游戏中，我们针对七种配置，将非规则性份额（1 − 基于规则的分数）与 Elo 评分进行关联，平局时使用平均排名。 12 场游戏的斯皮尔曼相关系数均值为 0.35 0.35，且各游戏间存在差异。 这种关联并不能证明替换规则就能提升策略。

paragraphs.en: The classification is automatic and approximate. Identifiers and comments influence it; we assign a mixed function to its dominant mechanism. Models retaining the same starter code have similar shares, as on AquaWar and LOTA .
